subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw support non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and if so should the currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds a public config and accounting/display contract across model config, session status, usage aggregation, Control UI, docs, and USD-named fields; source inspection cannot safely choose those semantics.

options.title: Define Currency Contract First
options.body: Choose scope, mixed-currency behavior, and accounting semantics before implementation so every cost surface stays consistent.

options.title: Keep USD-Only Costs
options.body: Leave configured model costs as USD estimates and document that local non-USD provider prices need conversion before entering config.

options.title: Add Display-Only Override
options.body: Allow a symbol/ISO display override while explicitly preserving USD-like stored totals and accepting that it is not billing-grade accounting.

recommendation.title: Define Currency Contract First
recommendation.body: Choose scope, mixed-currency behavior, and accounting semantics before implementation so every cost surface stays consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent-history connection to usage-cost semantics, config/docs contract work, and Control UI cost analysis.
